P-05 · Venue Product

Venue Command Center

One screen for everything happening in your venue.

Request a Demo WhatsApp

What it does

The operational heart of a smart venue. Venue Command Center fuses crowd analytics, device health, incident management and KPI dashboards into a single real-time picture — engineered with the same SOC/NOC discipline we run for enterprise security operations.

Features

Crowd Analytics

Density, flow and dwell heatmaps from camera and sensor fusion.

Device Monitoring

Live status of screens, sensors, network and AV endpoints.

Incident Management

Detect, assign, escalate and close incidents with audit trails.

Operations Dashboard

KPI wall for show days, footfall, uptime and response times.

Ideal for

  • ▸ Arena & stadium operators
  • ▸ Exhibition centres
  • ▸ Facilities management
  • ▸ Event control rooms

Built on

Every SMT product inherits our security engineering DNA: hardened infrastructure, SIEM-monitored operations, human-in-the-loop AI governance and sovereign deployment options (on-prem, private cloud or hybrid).

See it in your venue

Live walkthroughs run weekly from our Dubai office.
